feedback: Repair the conditional applicability logic: shipIceStrengthened must be a required true selector only when the applicable ice-condition evidence indicates ice strengthening; its absence or false value must make the requirement inapplicable rather than violate an unconditional sh:hasValue true constraint. Gate iceClass, both waterline relationships, all four minimum/maximum draught inputs, and the fore/aft inclusive-bound comparison under that applicability condition. Do not leave these sh:minCount constraints unconditional, and encode the upper/lower-waterline relationships as more than presence-only evidence where the verified relationship semantics require them.

Preserve the prior applicability repair: remove the sh:or branch that allows shipIceStrengthened=false to pass. Under the COMPLETE selector policy, require shipIceStrengthened=true and make absence or false inapplicable/violating as specified, with iceClass, both waterline relationships, all four draught bounds, and the comparison gated accordingly. Also invert the SPARQL violation logic: its SELECT must match only when either fore or aft operating draught is outside its inclusive minimum-to-maximum bounds; the current FILTER selects compliant cases and therefore creates an accidental fail-on-pass. Encode the upper/lower waterline relationships with their required semantic relationship checks rather than presence-only minCount constraints.

Locate the missing canonical waterline measurement/value term and path, then add the required owner-correct, unit-typed inclusive relationship checks without inventing a term or relocating properties.
